title: 第17章 世家掌盘王朝为棋第18章 订婚之日登门送礼
slug: 开局长生不死谁都以为我无敌
lines: 第17章世家掌盘，王朝为棋“父王，不知道您叫儿臣过来，所为何事？”
五皇子被大周国国主突然叫入宫中，心中也是有些不解。
毕竟这段时间，他一直都在为了即将到来的订婚宴做准备，难道是父王有关于这方面的事情找自己？
“我最近得到了一些消息，是关于陈家的。”
“你应该知道，陈家和柳家曾经的关系吧？”
大周国国主的一句话，让五皇子心头一震，怎么也没有料到，居然会是为了这件事情。
“回父王，这件事情我知道。”
“不过您放心，我已经让人去处理了，保证不会影响到任何事情。”
“您也知道，梦妍天赋不错，在上清宗也是被重点培养，而且我们两个人情投意合。”
“虽然柳家曾经和陈家有过一些契约，但这都已经过去了那么久，契约早就已经名存实亡。”
“父王，我不希望这件事情，会让你对梦妍有什么不好的印象。”
五皇子的话还没有说完，便被大周国国主抬手阻止了。
见父王眉头紧锁，五皇子的心中也十分紧张，生怕会影响到他和柳梦妍之间的关系。
“自己看看吧，这是北原郡郡守吴成峰送来的消息。”
大周国国主直接将吴成峰送过来的信件扔给了五皇子。
五皇子看到上面的内容之后，反而笑了起来。
“原来是这件事情。”
“父王，这事情我知道，放心，这不过是陈家的一个计谋罢了。”
“至于那所谓的老祖，我看就是一个笑话。”
“我已经让舅父帮忙，前去灭掉陈家了，算算时间，应该已经得手了。”五皇子笑着说道。
此话一出，大周国国主的眉头并没有松开，反而是死死的盯着五皇子。
“上面还有一个信息，你注意到了吗？”大周国国主问道。
“嗯？还有什么？”五皇子不解的问道。
“会说话的狗！”
“你的眼睛是用来出气的吗？”
“这么重要的消息你居然都给忽略了？”大周国国主终于按捺不住自己的脾气，直接大吼了一声。
狗？
什么狗？怎么还会说话？
五皇子愣是没反应过来，直接被大周国国主吼的大脑一片空白。
突然，五皇子不由得心头一震，会说话的狗？妖兽？
能够口吐人言的妖兽，必然是五阶之上，这……
一头五阶妖兽，便足以让大周国毁于一旦，何况是五阶之上？
这么重要的消息，柳梦妍为什么没有告诉自己？
“父王，这消息究竟是真是假？梦妍并没有跟我说过这件事情。”五皇子紧张的问道。
“吴成峰怕是还没有胆量和我说谎。”
“所以，这一条会说话的狗必然存在。”
“柳梦妍没说，有两种可能，一种是不知道，另外一种，是故意隐瞒。”
“不知道，梦妍一定是不知道，否则的话，她绝对不会期满我。”五皇子斩钉截铁的说道。
听到这话，大周国国主也是无奈的叹了一口气。
五皇子是他众多儿子之中最有天赋的一个，也是他最看好的人。
content_en:
Chapter 17 Aristocratic families are in charge, and dynasties are chess pieces. "Father, I don't know why you called your son over."
The fifth prince was suddenly called into the palace by the leader of the Great Zhou Kingdom, and he was a little puzzled.
After all, he had been preparing for the upcoming engagement party during this period. Could it be that his father wanted to ask him about this matter?
"I recently got some news about the Chen family."
"You should know the relationship between the Chen family and the Liu family, right?"
The words of the leader of the Great Zhou Kingdom shocked the fifth prince. He never expected that it would be for this matter.
"Back to my father, I know this."
"But don't worry, I've already asked someone to handle it. I guarantee it won't affect anything."
"You also know that Mengyan has a good talent, and she has been specially trained in the Shangqing Sect, and the two of us are very compatible."
"Although the Liu family once had some contracts with the Chen family, it has been so long that the contracts have long been in name only."
"Father, I don't want this matter to give you a bad impression of Meng Yan."
"I..."
Before the fifth prince finished speaking, the leader of the Great Zhou Kingdom raised his hand to stop him.
Seeing his father's frown, the fifth prince was also very nervous, fearing that it would affect the relationship between him and Liu Mengyan.
"Take a look for yourself. This is the news sent by Wu Chengfeng, the governor of Beiyuan County."
The leader of the Great Zhou Kingdom directly threw the letter sent by Wu Chengfeng to the fifth prince.
After the fifth prince saw the above content, he laughed instead.
"So that's what happened."
"Father, I know this. Don't worry, this is just a plan of the Chen family."
"As for the so-called ancestor, I think it's just a joke."
"I have asked my uncle to help me go to destroy the Chen family. If I count the time, I should have succeeded." The fifth prince said with a smile.
As soon as these words came out, the leader of the Great Zhou Kingdom did not loosen his brows. Instead, he stared at the fifth prince.
"There is another message on it, have you noticed it?" asked the leader of the Great Zhou Kingdom.
"Huh? What else?" the fifth prince asked in confusion.
"Dog!"
"Talking dog!"
"Are your eyes used to vent your anger?"
"You actually ignored such important news?" The leader of the Great Zhou Kingdom finally couldn't control his temper and yelled.
dog?
What dog? Why are you still talking?
The fifth prince was stunned and didn't react, and his mind went blank after being yelled at by the leader of the Great Zhou Kingdom.
"Father, this..."
Suddenly, the fifth prince couldn't help but feel shocked, a talking dog? Monster?
A monster that can speak human words must be above the fifth level. This...
A fifth-level monster is enough to destroy the Great Zhou Kingdom, let alone one above fifth level?
Why didn't Liu Mengyan tell herself such important news?
"Father, is this news true or false? Mengyan never told me about this matter." The fifth prince asked nervously.
"I'm afraid Wu Chengfeng doesn't have the guts to lie to me yet."
"So, this talking dog must exist."
"Liu Mengyan didn't say anything. There are two possibilities. One is that she doesn't know, and the other is that she deliberately concealed it."
"I don't know, Mengyan must not know, otherwise, she will never expire my term." The fifth prince said firmly.
Hearing this, the leader of the Great Zhou Kingdom also sighed helplessly.
The fifth prince is the most talented among his many sons, and he is also the one he is most optimistic about.
